Class Role

java.lang.Object
gate.entity.Role
All Implemented Interfaces:
gate.type.Hierarchy<Role>, Serializable
public class Role extends Object implements Serializable, gate.type.Hierarchy<Role>
A Role on the organization structure.

A Role can contain users, other roles and a list valueOf authorizations
